FINDER F4b, PART 2 OF 3 (THE LAST): PRODUCT E2E, REVIEW LAB, BUILD FLAG, WORKFLOW AND CONTRACT TESTS, AND THE RECORDS, ON THIS BRANCH. Parts 1a and 1b are already on this branch (commits a2e289e5 and 16f7f448): the picker, ranked cards, paging, URL selection, retained selected point, navigation.ts, the getSystem origin guard, AppShell/SystemOverlay/Inspect/Watchlist round trips. Read their components before writing selectors; do not rework them except where a change below needs it, and say why if you do.

AUTHORITY: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-10-v3-finder-f4-archetype-ui-design.md: section 8 "PR F4b" (the file list and its paragraphs), section 7 "Product Cypress E2E and fixture contract", "Review Lab" and "Visual validation and OpenAPI drift", and section 9's owner answers, where Question 1 as amended 2026-10-31 governs the fit label. Also docs/development/v3-browser-validation-lanes.md for which lane owns what.

REQUIRED, from the F4b list:
1. apps/web/cypress/e2e/product-journey.cy.ts: the section 7 Product E2E journey, steps 1-7 exactly: Any sends no min_development_score and shows no Minimum tier control; choose Flexible Multi-Role Colony with the keyboard; the URL carries archetype=flexible&page_size=1 and the real /api/archetypes/rankings request uses min_score=60, limit=1 and offset 0; the order V3 Lossless Reach, Achenar, HD 38179 with the selected score/tier, Best Colony Potential, evidence wording and Primary/Secondary text; Next through offsets 0, 1 and 2; the selected=<id64> URL, marker and state-carrying Inspect href; the clean-session reload that waits for GET /api/system/{id64}; Open in Explore restoring archetype, floor, page and selection; Back/Forward; axe; and 1280x800 and 390x844 screenshots with animation disabled. Take every expected value from the PostgreSQL fixture-output contract in tests/test_seed_cypress_v3_generation.py, never from guesses. The fit label on each row follows from the pinned scores: rival = the highest of the other non-Flexible archetype scores (for Flexible, the best of the other seven), ties to the earliest key in ARCHETYPE_KEYS order; "Clear fit" when the selected score is at least 3 above it, otherwise "Close fit · <rival display name> <rival score>". If the contract does not pin every archetype score needed for that, extend the contract (it is in the F4a file set; say so) rather than guessing. Do not stub any API response.
2. .github/workflows/cypress-parity.yml: add step-local VITE_FINDER_F4_ENABLED: '1' only to the "Build Svelte static bundle" step. Not at job scope, not on the preview step, nowhere else.
3. apps/web/Dockerfile and tests/test_v3_web_release_image.py: a validated build argument for VITE_FINDER_F4_ENABLED that defaults fail-closed to 0, accepts only 0 or 1, and is passed into the Svelte build. Assert all three in the test.
4. Review Lab: apps/api/src/review_main.py gains review-only modes rankings_api_failure (GET /api/archetypes/rankings answers a synthetic 503 tagged x-edfinder-review-failure: rankings-api-failure) and rankings_empty_results (a contract-shaped empty envelope: results [], total 0, is_truncated false, the normal ranking identity fields). apps/api/src/review_support_routes.py allows both modes in its scenario allowlist, with its contract tests. scripts/dev/review_lab/scenarios.py adds both scenarios and the flow keys rankingsApiFailure and rankingsEmptyResults. scripts/dev/review_lab/browser_runner.py adds VITE_FINDER_F4_ENABLED: '1' to the Review Lab bundle overrides and REQUIRED_CHECKS_BY_FLOW entries for both new flows, and records a ranking-failure-only run truthfully in the synthetic-failure summary. apps/web/cypress/e2e/review-lab.cy.ts adds both flows as section 7 describes, makes the console collector accept the rankings tag as an expected failure (with checks for both tags), and changes the existing apiFailure flow to establish a URL-owned selection first (visit /explore?selected=<REVIEW_SYSTEM.id64>, wait for the marker) and assert that exact selection and marker survive. scripts/dev/review_lab/support_matrix.py adds the rankings route with both scenarios, adds rankings_empty_results to the local-search row's scenario_coverage, and extends the control route's allowed_response_characteristics and scenario_coverage. tests/test_review_lab_v3.py covers the new modes, scenarios and matrix rows, including exact preservation of the local-search row's existing four scenarios plus rankings_empty_results.
5. Update the repository contracts that name or inspect cypress-parity.yml, and add a fail-closed assertion that the 1 opt-in is confined to that one build step: tests/test_browser_validation_lane_contract.py, tests/test_ci_data_invariants.py, tests/test_ci_dependency_contract.py, tests/test_ci_stall_detection.py, tests/test_e2e_harness_contract.py, tests/test_v3_product_journey_contract.py and tests/test_v3_python_runtime_validation.py. Change only what each one needs; if one needs no change, say so.
6. Records: a CHANGES.md entry at the top for F4b. In the F4 design, a section 1 status update saying F4b is implemented behind the default-off flag, which builds turn it on (the protected Product E2E bundle and the Review Lab bundle only), and that every gate before enabling it in a governed production or release build is unchanged; and note in section 8's F4b list the four inventory changes the earlier parts needed: archetypes.ts and archetypes.test.ts (the fit-label helper, after the 2026-10-31 amendment), the new navigation.ts and navigation.test.ts (the shared helper), SystemDetail.svelte and SystemDetail.test.ts (absent coordinates after the origin guard), and InspectPage.test.ts in place of +page.test.ts (SvelteKit reserves +-prefixed route files).

DO NOT CHANGE the ranking API, models, generated clients or migrations.

CHECKS TO RUN: in apps/web with Node 24 and pnpm 11.25.0: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, pnpm check, pnpm lint, pnpm format:check, pnpm test, pnpm build. Python: ruff check apps tests scripts shared_contracts, ruff check --select B905 apps tests scripts shared_contracts, and python -m pytest -q on every Python test module you changed plus tests/test_review_lab_v3.py and tests/test_seed_cypress_v3_generation.py (database tests in them will skip on this runner; say which). Cypress and Review Lab cannot run here: say so; CI runs them.
